leftEvidence.title: Jesus Christ and him crucified

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: Paul recalls arriving without elevated speech, determining to know Christ crucified, speaking in weakness, and distinguishing God’s wisdom from rulers who crucified the Lord of glory.
points.right: Paul addresses the Galatians with questions about hearing, faith, Spirit, flesh, suffering, and the public portrayal of Jesus Christ as crucified.

payload.posture: Two Pauline arguments recall how the crucified Christ was first presented to their hearers.
